mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves ordered pattern comparison, offset shifting, cross-record agreement, and investigation of displaced increments. However, physically secured leaf order does not establish temporal order of production. Whether the leaf and revision-layer series actually preserve that order determines whether shifting them implements temporal crossdating.

warrant_validity.rationale: The proposed agreement can identify candidate sequences, but it does not warrant all the stated chronological and assembly inferences. The assumed shared working conditions explain how contemporary writing could share features; they do not establish that matching features identify the same period. Independent recording and feature holdouts do not establish temporal specificity, and a unique leaf offset does not itself establish chronological bounds from anchors. Likewise, continuous pagination or common correcting ink does not independently establish a single later event bringing the units together. The mapping acknowledges relevant alternatives but supplies no specific unresolved relation sufficient to establish these stronger bridges. Calling the result a ranked hypothesis preserves uncertainty but does not supply those bridges.

target_fidelity.rationale: The proposed inference directly concerns revision order, assembly, and remaining uncertainty in the surviving draft. Its scope fits the retained target; the defects concern the evidential support for that inference.

conditions.condition: The physically secured leaf orders and separately recorded revision-layer series preserve temporal formation order independently of the features used for alignment.
conditions.rationale: Crossdating requires ordered temporal records. Binding, textual continuity, or foliation can secure a documentary order without securing the order in which its contents were produced.

conditions.condition: Matching feature transitions identify shared composition periods at sufficient resolution to place units and transfer bounded dates from anchors.
conditions.rationale: The mapping supplies a hypothesis of shared changing working conditions, but no adequate inverse relationship from feature agreement to chronological position. Its stopping rules and holdouts do not establish that relationship, particularly with recurrent features, unequal temporal spans per leaf, and possible copying.

conditions.condition: The unit-spanning feature identifies a shared later assembly event.
conditions.rationale: A pagination run or common correcting ink can span units without independently demonstrating when they were brought together or that the feature represents one later assembly stage. The mapping supplies no discriminating relationship establishing that interpretation.

conditions.condition: The draft and any witnesses or correspondence used in the procedure are accessible for inspection and recording.
conditions.rationale: Document access enables the specified observations. It does not establish temporal ordering, feature specificity, anchor applicability, or the assembly interpretation.

preconditions.condition: The draft and any witnesses or correspondence used in the procedure are accessible for inspection and recording.
preconditions.how_to_establish: Obtain access to the documents used for segmentation, feature recording, physical inspection, and anchoring.
preconditions.why_execution_only: Access permits execution of the proposed procedure without changing what its observations warrant.

execution_readiness.rationale: The packet supplies no documents or established access. Satisfying access requirements would enable execution but would leave the substantive validity issues unresolved.

uncertainty: The packet does not establish whether documentary order tracks temporal formation order in this draft.
The actual feature histories, anchors, copying relationships, and physical evidence are unknown; no observed outcome is assumed.
